description: Gate an active goal on its anchor and re-state the sections it may change, restore its frozen spec and carried state after a session or compaction boundary, record a failed delegation via PostToolUseFailure so a degraded round cannot read as a clean one, and record a recovered delegation via PostToolUse so recovery is a positive observation rather than a turn-boundary inference. Silent in any project without a .goals/active marker. This file is auto-discovered by Claude Code and zCode alike, so it carries only the events both hosts document: zCode has no PreCompact at all (that lives in hooks/claude.json and hooks/codex.json), and Codex, whose manifest replaces discovery with its own file, does not document PostToolUseFailure. The script root resolves zCode's documented ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT too - under it alone the old chain turned every path into /skills/... and silently loaded nothing. Every matcher here is "*" and none is "": zCode 0.16.5's own hooks documentation writes "matcher": "" in its Stop example, and that value makes the host reject this whole file while reporting "Model config is missing" - a section that is intact. Bisected against a working config: "" fails, ".*" and "*" load.

hooks.command: R="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; H=""; [ -n "$R" ] || { R="${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; H="--host zcode"; }; [ -n "$R" ] || R="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; P="$R/skills/ultragoal/scripts/goal_stop.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P" $H; else exec python "$P" $H; fi
hooks.commandWindows: (if not exist "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_stop.py" exit 0) & where py >nul 2>nul || exit 0 & py -3 "%CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT%\skills\ultragoal\scripts\goal_stop.py"
